purpose: Teach: 血糖/プラズマ/精子/形容詞/同胞/軍国/乳幼児/生誕

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、糖尿病患者の血糖値管理研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on blood glucose management in diabetic patients, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, measured, attentive. Slight lift at the end — genuinely interested. The tone of a teacher who's read the work and wants to hear what the student thinks about it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、プラズマ技術の応用研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on plasma technology applications.
lines.style: Quiet but clear. A slight hesitation before the answer, as if correcting course. Not defensive — just precise. Eyes down, then up.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、不妊治療における精子の検査を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper covered fertility treatment and sperm analysis, correct?
lines.style: Slower, more deliberate. Eyes on Ren with gentle curiosity. A pause before speaking, like she's giving him space to process the question. Not pushing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、日本語の形容詞の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the history of Japanese adjectives.
lines.style: Small, contained correction. Steady voice. Acknowledging the misalignment without apology. Matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 在外同胞コミュニティの研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You addressed overseas Korean communities in your research, didn't you?
lines.style: Open, inviting. Genuinely trying to connect the dots. Warm without presumption. A slight nod, as if prompting him forward.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、軍国主義時代の教育を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my paper examined education during the militaristic era.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Each word precise and deliberate. Not hurried. A small exhale after speaking, like he's said what needed to be said.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、乳幼児の発達心理学を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on developmental psychology in infants and toddlers, wasn't it?
lines.style: Reflective, almost gently probing. Slower pacing. She's listening as much as asking. A tiny pause between phrases, like she's thinking alongside him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、ルネサンス期の生誕図像を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote on nativity imagery during the Renaissance.
lines.style: Final answer, quieter than before. Small, controlled closure. A breath at the end. Eyes steady, tone resolved. Not exhausted — settled.
